verdict.rationale: The read endpoint returns JSON by default, with SRT/VTT as alternatives. The docs describe segment-level structure: chronological segments streamed via SSE, a configurable segment_duration, speaker_id added per segment, per-word start/end times, and audio-type labels. A segment confidence threshold filter implies each segment carries a confidence score. Missing for 10: an explicit output schema showing confidence fields returned in the JSON, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the response structure.
